challenges.statement: The SDUI payload packs 13 distinct interactive components into a single view (including 3 goal cards, projection charts, metric tiles, educational guides, sync status, and expiring alerts), creating excessive cognitive load and violating component density guidelines.

releaseReasons: Component overload: 13 simultaneous components overwhelm the user interface and compromise readability and cognitive accessibility.

agentMessages.summary: Holding release due to component overload (13 components on a single screen violates cognitive load limits).
